_doc: Electrical limits of each active part, by MPN, from the manufacturer's datasheet (source per part). The F1 circuit model (sim/osc_sim/circuit.py) only trusts guaranteed points: a logic input is high at VIH or above and low at VIL or below, a MOSFET conducts when VGS reaches the gate voltage at which RDS(on) is specified and is off below its minimum VGS(th), an opto fires at its maximum IFT and a relay closes at its must-operate voltage. Anything between the two points is undefined and fails the check.

STM32G431RBT6.source: ST DS12589 rev 6, table 55 I/O static characteristics and table 56 output voltage characteristics (CMOS port, |IIO| = 8 mA, VDD >= 2.7 V); NRST weak pull-up RPU.
STM32G431RBT6.vin_max_source: table 19 voltage characteristics: input voltage on pins other than FT_xxx 4.0 V (FT_xxx min(VDD, VDDA) + 4.0 V); 4.0 V is taken for every pin

ESP32-S3-WROOM-1U-N8R8.source: Espressif ESP32-S3 datasheet, table 5-4 DC characteristics (3.3 V): VIH 0.75 x VDD, VIL 0.25 x VDD, VIH max VDD + 0.3 V; VOH 0.8 x VDD; IOH 40 mA at 2.64 V with PAD_DRIVER 3 (20 mA taken, the default drive 2); RPU/RPD 45 kOhm.

SN74LVC2G08DCTR.source: TI SCES198N, 6.3 recommended operating conditions (VCC 3 V to 3.6 V, input transition rate 10 ns/V max; no hysteresis) and 6.5 electrical characteristics.

SN74LVC1G17DBVR.source: TI SCES351, pin functions (DBV: 1 NC, 2 A, 3 GND, 4 Y, 5 VCC) and table 5-1 at VCC 3 V: VT+ 1.92 V max, VT- 0.89 V min; IOH -100 uA at VCC - 0.1 V, 24 mA drive; Schmitt input, no transition-rate limit.

TPS3828-33DBVR.source: TI SLVS165O, 6.5/6.8: VIT- 2.93 V (TPS382x-33), WDI VIH 0.7 x VDD and VIL 0.3 x VDD, ttout 0.9/1.6/2.5 s, td 120/200/300 ms, open-drain RESET (7.3.3), RESET VOL 0.4 V at 1.2 mA. 7.3.4: the non-A devices latch RESET low if a WDI pulse is received while RESET is asserted.

SI2308A.source: UMW SI2308A datasheet, Nov 2024, 5 electrical characteristics: VGS(th) 1-3 V at 250 uA; RDS(on) 95 mOhm max at VGS 4.5 V, 80 mOhm at 10 V; VDS 60 V.

BSS138LT1G.source: onsemi BSS138LT1/D: VGS(th) 0.5-1.5 V; rDS(on) 10 Ohm max at VGS 2.75 V, ID < 200 mA, -40 to 85 C; VDSS 50 V; ID 200 mA.

UCC27517DBVR.source: TI SLUSAY4D, 6.5: VIN_H 2.4 V max, VIN_L 1.0 V min, UVLO 4.2 V typical rising; ROH 7.5 Ohm and ROL 1 Ohm max at VDD 12 V. Absolute maximum VDD 20 V (8.1).

DRV8876PWPR.source: TI SLVSDS7B, 6.5: EN/IN1, PH/IN2 and nSLEEP VIH 1.5 V min, VIL 0.8 V max (VM >= 5 V), RPD 100 kOhm; AIPROPI 1000 uA/A; tWAKE 1 ms; PMODE low = PH/EN (table 2); IMODE to GND = fixed off-time, automatic retry (table 6); nFAULT open drain.

TPS22918DBVR.source: TI SLVSD76C, 6.5: VIH,ON 1 V min, VIL,ON 0.5 V max; RON 53 mOhm typical at VIN 3.3 V.

MOC3083.source: Lite-On MOC3083 datasheet: IFT 5 mA max (latches output), recommended IF between IFT max and 50 mA absolute maximum; VF 1.4 V max at 20 mA; output ITSM 1 A; zero-cross inhibit 20 V max.

BTA24-800BWRG.source: ST BTA24 datasheet DS2117: BW (snubberless) IGT 50 mA max, VGT 1.3 V max, quadrants I-II-III.

G5RL-1A-E-TV8 DC24.source: Omron G5RL datasheet, high-inrush TV8 coil ratings: 24 VDC, 16.7 mA, 1440 Ohm +/-10 %, must operate 70 % max, must release 10 % min, 130 % max.

AP63203WU-7.source: Diodes AP63200/1/3/5 datasheet, absolute maximum ratings: VIN and EN -0.3 to +35 V DC, VSW -1 V to VIN + 0.3 V.

AP63200WU-7.source: Diodes AP63200/1/3/5 datasheet, absolute maximum ratings: VIN and EN -0.3 to +35 V DC, VSW -1 V to VIN + 0.3 V.

SMAJ18A.source: JUXING / Littelfuse SMAJ series: SMAJ18A VWM 18 V, VBR 20.0-22.1 V at 1 mA, VC 29.2 V at IPP 13.7 A.

SMAJ15A.source: Littelfuse SMAJ series datasheet: SMAJ15A VWM 15 V, VBR 16.7-18.5 V at 1 mA, VC 24.4 V at IPP 16.4 A.

SN74LVC1G132DBVR.source: TI SCES538, pin functions (DBV: 1 A, 2 B, 3 GND, 4 Y, 5 VCC) and 6.5 at VCC 3 V: VT+ 1.87 V max, VT- 0.84 V min; Schmitt inputs.

TMCS1133B4AQDVGR.source: TI SBOSAG0E, pin functions and 6.9: B4 option 100 mV/A, VOUT 1.65 V at 0 A with VS 3.3 V (VS/2 assumed for other VS), linear -15.5 to 15.5 A at 3.3 V, RIN 0.7 mOhm, swing VS-0.05 V and GND+0.01 V, VS 3 to 5.5 V; output resistance not given, 5 Ohm stand-in.

0215004.MXEP.source: Littelfuse 215 Series datasheet (revised 01/12/17), Electrical Characteristic Specifications by Item: 4 A, 250 V, interrupting rating 1500 A at 250 VAC (0.125-12 A), nominal cold resistance 0.0185 ohm, nominal melting I2t 46.96 A2s (I2t test at 10x rated current).

0215001.MXP.source: Littelfuse 215 Series datasheet (revised 01/12/17), Electrical Characteristic Specifications by Item: 1 A, 250 V, interrupting rating 1500 A at 250 VAC (0.125-12 A), nominal cold resistance 0.1515 ohm, nominal melting I2t 1.52 A2s (I2t test at 10x rated current).

0215012.MXEP.source: Littelfuse 215 Series datasheet (revised 01/12/17), Electrical Characteristic Specifications by Item: 12 A, 250 V, interrupting rating 1500 A at 250 VAC (0.125-12 A), nominal cold resistance 0.0061 ohm, nominal melting I2t 515.5 A2s (I2t test at 10x rated current).
